# Qbits Energy

> Qbits Inverters Limited is an Indian solar inverter manufacturer (a subsidiary of Heaven Green Energy Limited). We design and build BIS/IEC-certified on-grid and hybrid solar inverters for residential, commercial, and industrial use across India, backed by an 8 + 4 year warranty, IP66 enclosures, German IGBTs, and AI-powered WhatsApp monitoring on Indian servers.

Headquartered in Surat, Gujarat. Product range covers 1.5 kW residential string inverters through 320 kW C&I units. We sell through a dealer network, EPCs, and direct B2B; we are not on Amazon.

## Company

- [About Qbits](https://qbitsenergy.com/about-us/): Company story, leadership, ISO 9001 certification, Adani Solar distributorship.
- [Why Qbits](https://qbitsenergy.com/why-qbits/): Build quality, India-tuned engineering, 8 + 4 year warranty, IP66 protection.
- [Contact](https://qbitsenergy.com/contact-us/): Sales, service, partnership enquiries. Surat HQ.
- [Authorized Service Partners](https://qbitsenergy.com/authorized-service-partners/): Pan-India installation, maintenance, and warranty support map.

## Solutions

- [Residential](https://qbitsenergy.com/residential-solution/): 1 kW–10 kW home rooftop systems.
- [Commercial & Industrial](https://qbitsenergy.com/c-i-solution/): Factories, warehouses, schools, hospitals, hotels.

## Key Topics Covered in Blog

- Solar inverter buying guides for 1 kW, 2 kW, 3 kW, 5 kW, and 10 kW systems.
- On-grid vs hybrid vs off-grid comparisons.
- PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana eligibility, subsidy amounts, application process, and status checks.
- Kusum Yojana for agricultural solar.
- State-by-state solar subsidies (Gujarat, Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, UP, Karnataka, Kerala, MP, Rajasthan, Telangana, West Bengal, Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Delhi).
- Solar financing: SBI, HDFC, IREDA, RESCO/OPEX models, EMI.
- Inverter technology deep dives: MPPT, dual-MPPT vs single, transformerless, three-phase, anti-islanding, BMS, reactive power.
- Reliability and maintenance: IP65 vs IP66, monsoon prep, summer derating, ground faults, troubleshooting error codes.
- Brand comparisons: Qbits vs Sungrow, Growatt, Luminous, Microtek, Deye, UTL, Goodwe, Solis.
- Indian solar market data, statistics, and rooftop capacity by state.
